label: Engine is ViZDoom
body: The engine is ViZDoom, not chocolate-doom, doomgeneric, or a from-scratch WAD parser, because it already exposes framebuffer, pose, objects, automap, and a button action space.

label: Ship Freedoom or shareware only
body: Ship Freedoom or the shareware IWAD; do not redistribute a commercial WAD.

label: Live path is foxglove-sdk WebSocket
body: The live path is foxglove-sdk WebSocket with ClientPublish on ws://localhost:8765, not rosbridge, not a custom protocol, and not LeRobot display_mode=foxglove.

label: v1 uses stock Foxglove panels only
body: v1 uses stock panels only (Image, 3D, Teleop, Gauge, Plot, Log, Raw Messages, Table); no custom HUD extension until gauges are proven too generic.

label: Movement is Twist on /cmd_vel
body: Movement is geometry_msgs/Twist on /cmd_vel from the Teleop panel; fire, use, and weapon live on /doom/buttons; WASD in the embed publishes the same topics and does not replace Teleop.

label: Public surface is embedded Foxglove
body: The public and kiosk surface is embedded Foxglove with parent-owned live transport and programmatic Play, Debug, and Replay layouts.

label: No host-canvas game view
body: Do not custom-render the game in a host canvas; if the image is not a Foxglove Image panel subscription, the stunt failed.

label: Keep tank controls, no mouse-look
body: Keep id Tech 1 tank controls as a diff-drive robot metaphor; no mouse-look FPS.

label: Only Grok fast and Kimi K3
body: Every spawned sub-agent uses only cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast or kimi-k3-high; no Claude, no GPT, no Composer, no inherit.

label: A producer may not grade its own work
body: A model that produces a deliverable may not grade it; generators are Grok and critics and evaluators are Kimi K3.

label: Durable state lives under .agent/
body: Durable state lives under .agent/; chat is not a source of truth; agents write findings to files and do not dump the knowledge graph into chat.

label: Product workstreams run in locked order
body: Product workstreams run in order harness, hero loop, robotics layout, embed shell, record/replay; stunt extras stay deferred until 01 through 03 are evaluated done.

label: Farama-Foundation/ViZDoom
body: github.com/Farama-Foundation/ViZDoom is the locked engine: headless framebuffer, pose, objects, automap, and a button action space built for AI research.

label: foxglove/foxglove-sdk WebSocket server
body: github.com/foxglove/foxglove-sdk provides start_server(), ClientPublish, and foxglove.CompressedImage, which is the locked live path.

label: freedoom/freedoom IWAD
body: github.com/freedoom/freedoom supplies the legal IWAD (Freedoom Phase 1 E1M1); shareware doom1.wad is the other allowed option; commercial WADs are forbidden.

label: gasmith/foxglove-lunar-lander analog
body: github.com/gasmith/foxglove-lunar-lander is the closest public analog: Foxglove SDK used as a game UI rather than a canvas next to Foxglove.

label: ViZDoom may fail to install on this Mac
body: ViZDoom wheels may be missing for this darwin/Python pair, so pip may try a source build that needs cmake, boost, and sdl2. Mitigation: keep a working foxglove-sdk server plus smoke test even if ViZDoom import fails, document the IWAD and ViZDoom install, and prefer a real ViZDoom path when the import succeeds.

label: A commercial IWAD must never be shipped
body: Redistributing doom.wad or doom2.wad from a retail copy would fail the legal constraint. Mitigation: only Freedoom or shareware; wad/ is for those files; never vendor a commercial WAD.

body: Owns GOAL.md, COORDINATION.md, the knowledge graph, the workstream tree, the loop specifications, and the Cursor rule; contract items are prefixed H-.

body: Deferred. Will own /doom/map grid, /tf player transform, /doom/entities SceneUpdate, gauges, /doom/log, and exported Play and Debug layouts; contract items are prefixed RL-.

label: 03-embed-shell: host page plus WASD
body: Deferred. Will own the embedded Foxglove host page, parent-owned live transport, WASD keybindings on the same topics, and the layout switcher; contract items are prefixed ES-.

body: Deferred. Will own MCAP recording from the same SDK code and the Replay layout with Teleop hidden; contract items are prefixed RR-.

body: Deferred until 01 through 03 are evaluated done. Will own events, comparison, agent prompts, and remote spectator; contract items are prefixed SX-.

body: Live Foxglove SDK WebSocket defaults to host 127.0.0.1 or localhost and port 8765, not rosbridge.

label: ClientPublish is enabled with JSON client encoding
body: start_server is called with Capability.ClientPublish and supported_encodings including json.

label: /doom/camera is foxglove.CompressedImage JPEG 320x200 at 35 Hz
body: /doom/camera publishes foxglove.CompressedImage JPEG 320x200; TICK_HZ is 35 and run_loop paces to that period.

label: /cmd_vel Twist: linear.x, angular.z, optional linear.y, zero stops
body: /cmd_vel accepts Twist-shaped JSON; linear.x is forward/back, angular.z is turn, linear.y is strafe, zero Twist stops.

label: /doom/buttons JSON { fire, use, weapon }
body: /doom/buttons accepts JSON {fire, use, weapon} and maps fire/use onto ViZDoom ATTACK/USE.

label: Tank controls; no mouse-look
body: Controls are id Tech 1 tank/diff-drive; no mouse-look or LOOK_UP/LOOK_DOWN buttons.

label: One smoke command from repo root
body: ./smoke from repo root exits 0 on success with camera and Twist, and exits non-zero on _fail.

label: ClientPublish proven over a real socket, not only apply_raw()
body: An in-repo check must prove ClientPublish, camera advertise, Twist, and buttons over a real WebSocket, not only apply_raw().

label: TeleopListener implements on_subscribe and on_unsubscribe
body: TeleopListener must implement callable on_subscribe and on_unsubscribe so the SDK does not AttributeError.

label: Busy 8765 is an environment note; smoke may bind ephemeral
body: Smoke may bind ephemeral when 8765 is busy and must document the live default; occupied 8765 is not a product FAIL.

label: README documents install, smoke, live WS, Image plus Teleop
body: README documents install, ./smoke, live ws://localhost:8765, Image plus Teleop, Freedoom, and no host canvas.

label: No host-canvas renderer
body: The marine view is a Foxglove Image subscription to /doom/camera, not a host canvas renderer.

label: @foxglove/embed parent-owned transport
body: npm package @foxglove/embed provides FoxgloveViewer, selectLayout, setKeybindings, and ParentTransportFactory used by the embed-shell host page.

label: /doom/map is foxglove.Grid once per level
body: /doom/map is a foxglove.Grid occupancy published once per level; later ticks in the same level omit the grid.

label: /tf is FrameTransforms map to base_link
body: /tf publishes foxglove.FrameTransforms with parent map and child base_link from the marine pose.

label: /doom/entities is foxglove.SceneUpdate
body: /doom/entities publishes foxglove.SceneUpdate cubes for non-player entities in frame map, including an empty update.

label: /doom/player compact JSON six fields
body: /doom/player is compact JSON with health, armor, ammo, weapon, tick, and dead; a hash-named schema is allowed.

label: /doom/log is foxglove.Log
body: /doom/log publishes foxglove.Log for level-enter, death, and pickup messages with name doom.

label: ./smoke no --hero exits 0
body: ./smoke with no --hero exits 0, prints SMOKE OK naming the five 02 topics, and keeps _check_layouts plus the five _fail hooks.

label: Wire delivery of 02 topics
body: ./smoke must receive /doom/map, /tf, /doom/entities, /doom/player, and /doom/log over foxglove.sdk.v1 and print WIRE LAYOUT; publish_world dicts and /tmp probes do not count.

label: Play.json Image Teleop gauges
body: layouts/Play.json version 1 walks to Image /doom/camera, Teleop /cmd_vel at 35 Hz stop-on-release, and health/armor/ammo gauges; no GUI import.

label: Debug.json adds 3D plot log raw
body: layouts/Debug.json version 1 adds ThreeDee map/entities, Plot health+ammo vs timestamp, Log /doom/log, and RawMessages /doom/player; no GUI import.

label: No canvas foxe MCAP embed in 02 files
body: 02-owned topics/world/layouts_export and Play/Debug JSON must not add canvas, .foxe, MCAP, or embed; presence of 03/04 files does not fail 02.

label: Host page embeds Foxglove via @foxglove/embed in web/
body: web/ constructs FoxgloveViewer from @foxglove/embed; host owns chrome and Play/Debug switching, not a custom game renderer.

label: Parent-owned live transport; pending Pro plus quoted fallback allowed
body: ParentTransportFactory opens the live foxglove-websocket; pending waits; unavailable may use iframe-owned plus connectDirect if that path is quoted.

label: Force-load Play.json and Debug.json
body: selectLayout is called with storageKey, opaqueLayout, and force true for both layouts/Play.json and layouts/Debug.json.

body: Host keybindings publish geometry_msgs/Twist on /cmd_vel and buttons JSON on /doom/buttons; WASD does not replace Teleop.

body: layouts/Play.json still contains a Teleop panel; compile-check and host throw if Play drops it.

label: No host-canvas game view
body: web/src and web/index.html must not create a host canvas or getContext renderer; the marine view is a Foxglove Image panel.

label: @foxglove/common shim is explicit and documented

body: From repo root, ./smoke-replay prints SMOKE-REPLAY OK and exits 0; busy 8765 with ephemeral bind is not a product FAIL.

body: README.md documents ./smoke-replay, opening recordings/smoke.mcap as a local file, importing layouts/Replay.json, and using the playback bar.

body: /doom/events is JSON with required keys kind, message, tick, and map on EVENTS_SCHEMA, not a LogChannel.

label: kind is death, weapon, level, or pickup
body: Tagged event kinds are exactly death, weapon, level, and pickup; publish_world only logs kinds in EVENT_KINDS.

body: From repo root, ./smoke-events prints SMOKE-EVENTS OK and exits 0; busy 8765 with ephemeral bind is not a product FAIL.

label: POST /pause stops engine.step and closes the sidecar writer
body: POST /pause sets stop_event, calls writer.close() on the open_recording sink, returns 200 paused true, and is idempotent; run_loop takes optional stop_event=None.

label: GET /recording returns closed sidecar bytes or 409
body: GET /recording is 409 before pause and 200 application/octet-stream after pause with recording on; OPTIONS and CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin are present.

label: Embed #pause-replay loads FileSource plus Replay layout
body: Host chrome #pause-replay POSTs pause, GETs the sidecar as a File, setDataSource type file autoplay true, and selectLayout replayLayoutParams with layout not opaqueLayout.

label: Control URL is ?control= then VITE_FOXGLOVE_CONTROL then 8764
body: readControlUrl reads firstQuery control then VITE_FOXGLOVE_CONTROL then DEFAULT_CONTROL_URL http://localhost:8764; web/README.md documents --control-port and the 8766 plus ?control= pairing.

label: ./web/check includes Replay selectLayout and FileSource
body: compile-check.ts exports replaySelectLayoutCompileCheck with layout plus force true and fileSourceCompileCheck type file autoplay true; ./web/check still prints EMBED CHECK OK.

label: ./smoke-pause-replay records, pauses, and asserts topics
body: ./smoke-pause-replay runs open_recording plus run_loop on a thread with stop_event, POSTs /pause, GETs /recording, and prints SMOKE-PAUSE-REPLAY OK with pre_pause=409 double_pause=ok step_stopped=ok.

label: --no-record pause still stops; GET is 409
body: With --no-record, POST /pause still stops the engine and GET /recording stays 409; embed #status mentions recording is off.
